newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares well-traded, index dips.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares well-traded, index dips.

text.p: The Estonian share market saw healthy business on Friday although the stock exchange index dipped slightly, the bourse said.
The official list turnover reached 40.4 million kroons while the Tallinn stock exchange index fell 0.2 percent to 131.18.
Number two bank Savings Bank was the most traded stock with volume of 17.2 million kroons but it closed lower at 60.25 kroons versus 63.95.
Market leader Hansapank saw trade of 13.7 million kroons and ended higher at 133.25 kroons versus 132.92 kroons, maintaining its recent rally.
Shares in Tallinna Pank saw trade of three million kroons and ended at 48 kroons, unchanged from yesterday.
The over-the-counter market had a dull day with just 3.2 million kroons of stock changing hands.
The most-traded share was the Rakvere meat producer on volume of 1.4 million kroons and ending slightly higher at 6.55 kroons.
